messages:
ashley: kicking off a slimbridge-13b:v3 catalog enable tonight in the 23:00-00:00 UTC window. plan: micro canary at 10% for 20m, then 40% for 30m if green.
ravi: noted. can we exclude regulated/gov tenants from the initial canary (pin them to slimbridge-13b:v2)?
ashley: yes. we'll apply a short-lived pin for selector 'gov' -> slimbridge-13b:v2 before the window.
nora: fallback ordering proposal: 1) tenant pin (if present), 2) slimbridge-13b:v2 (previous stable), 3) atlas-8b-quant (cheaper fallback). keep v3 as primary when healthy.
tim: metrics/alerting thresholds? recommend p95 > 900ms OR error_count > baseline * 2 for 5m triggers immediate rollback. also watch qps drop > 12% sustained 2m.
sre-ops: add escalation: page oncall if p95 > 1100ms OR error_rate spike persists > 10m. dashboards: https://console/redwood/dashboards/slimbridge13b-canary
ashley: deploy-bot, queue the micro-enable and include monitors tag 'slimbridge-canary-ops'.
deploy-bot: queued: /run deploy catalog enable slimbridge-13b:v3 --micro 10% --window=2026-03-25T23:00Z-00:00Z --monitors=p50,p95,errors,qps
ravi: rollforward/rollback commands for ops?
deploy-bot: rollback (full): `/run deploy catalog rollback --model=slimbridge-13b:v3 --to=slimbridge-13b:v2 --reason="canary-failure"`
deploy-bot: partial stop (canary only): `/run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=slimbridge-13b:v3 --percent=0`
ashley: preflight checklist to confirm before +5m: 1) pin applied for gov tenants, 2) smoke eval (SMOKE_CANARY_SET) passes locally, 3) alerts wired and oncall ack.
nora: i'll run the smoke eval and post results in-thread. focusing on hallucination diff and safety prompts.
tim: include cost watch: token/sec baseline and estimated delta. if token utilization > expected +30% abort and rollback.
ravi: i'm creating the temporary pin now: `POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"gov","model":"slimbridge-13b:v2","ttl":"2h"}`. will confirm when done.
sre-ops: pin applied and verified in the catalog.
ashley: thanks. assigning oncall: @tim (primary) @sre-ops (backup) for 00:00-02:00 UTC.
tim: i'll be on pager, will keep an eye on dashboards and the live thread. :thumbsup:
nora: smoke eval: PASS. hallucination delta within threshold (0.6%). ready for rollout.
ashley: pushing job at +8m to give pins time to propagate. will post progress updates.
deploy-bot: starting micro canary now: 10% -> scheduled. will report metrics at +5m, +20m.
sre-ops: initial 5m: p50=120ms p95=430ms errors=baseline. no alert.
ravi: looks clean from our side.
ashley: proceeding to 40% after planned steady period.
deploy-bot: scaling to 40% now.
sre-ops: 10m after scale: p95=520ms, errors slightly up but < threshold. no page.
tim: cost delta within expected. continuing watch.
ashley: if anything flares, follow rollback commands. otherwise we'll update changelog and post a short release note after the window.
ravi: noted. i will remove the gov pin 30m after finish if everything stable.
ashley: great team, thank you. end-of-thread updates will be posted to #release-notes once checked off.
